{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Gacer'grocinga''''' was a [[Gacerite]] title meaning "leader of artists." It was bestowed upon [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Ulbrek Gostech]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ruler of [[Gacerian]].
